vendor: Brandmark (brandmark.io) - indie AI logo design tool operating under the name "Brandmark" per its Terms of Service; independently founded by Jack Qiao and live since 2017. No formal operating legal entity is named on the vendor's own site; the Terms of Service state Canadian governing law (Burnaby, BC). Two unrelated same-name entities appear in external registries and are not this vendor: Brandmark LLC, a local marketing/signage firm at 349 Marhil Ct, Crystal Lake, Illinois; and BRANDMARK.IO LIMITED, a dissolved UK shell (Companies House #15590183).
product_family: AI-powered logo and brand identity design tool. Generates logos, business cards, social media graphics, brand guides, and website templates. Free tier with pay-once or subscription models.

flags: Third-party reviews (VisionStack AI, 10web.io) claim 'regular audits', 'compliance certifications', and 'end-to-end encryption', but Brandmark's own privacy policy and terms do not document these; the privacy policy only mentions encryption in transit for credit card information, with no mention of audits or a formal compliance program.

The vendor's own site names only 'Brandmark' as operator, with no formal legal entity given. Two unrelated same-name entities appear in external registries and are not this vendor: (1) Brandmark LLC, a local marketing/signage firm at 349 Marhil Ct, Crystal Lake, Illinois (listed under Marketing on business directories), which is not the SaaS logo tool; (2) BRANDMARK.IO LIMITED, a UK shell (Companies House #15590183) registered at the Companies House default PO Box address, incorporated March 24, 2024 and dissolved November 5, 2024, with no evidence linking it to this tool (which has operated since 2017). The Terms of Service state Canadian governing law (Burnaby, BC), consistent with founder Jack Qiao's Canadian base.
No documentation exists on whether user-generated logo designs or input data are used to train future models; the privacy policy is silent on this, a notable transparency gap for AI tools.
No GDPR compliance documentation exists despite the tool serving potential EU users, and no DPA is offered.
No information is available on where user data and generated designs are stored or processed.
The privacy policy does not specify how long user account data and designs are retained after account closure or deletion.
The vendor has no dedicated security, trust, or compliance page, only a basic privacy policy and terms of service.

The only explicit security measure documented is encryption in transit for credit card information; there is no mention of encryption at rest, security audits, incident response, access controls, or vendor security assessments.
